lines.en: Hello, I ordered something ten days ago and it has not arrived.
lines.tr: Merhaba, on gün önce bir şey sipariş ettim ve gelmedi.

lines.en: Can you give me the number on your message?
It is four, seven, two, nine, one.
Thank you. I can see it. It came to the city on Monday.
Monday? Then where is it now?
The driver went to your address twice. Nobody was at home.
lines.tr: Şoför adresinize iki kez gitmiş. Kimse evde yokmuş.

lines.en: I work until six every day. Can he come in the evening?
lines.tr: Her gün altıya kadar çalışıyorum. Akşam gelebilir mi?

lines.en: Not after six, but you can take it from our office.
lines.tr: Altıdan sonra olmaz ama ofisimizden alabilirsiniz.

lines.en: Where is the office and when does it close?
lines.tr: Ofis nerede ve ne zaman kapanıyor?

lines.en: Near the bus station. It is open until eight.
That is fine. I will come tomorrow after work.
Bring something with your name on it, please.
lines.tr: Üzerinde adınız yazan bir şey getirin lütfen.

questions.q: When did Tugce order?
questions.note: "I ordered something ten days ago."

questions.q: When did it arrive in the city?
questions.note: "It came to the city on Monday."

questions.q: Why could the driver not deliver it?
questions.note: "The driver went to your address twice. Nobody was at home."

questions.q: Until when is the office open?
questions.note: "It is open until eight."

questions.q: What must she bring?
options: Something with her name on it
questions.note: "Bring something with your name on it."

lines.en: Good morning. What is the problem?
This tooth hurts when I drink something cold.
lines.tr: Soğuk bir şey içince bu dişim ağrıyor.

lines.en: How long has this been happening?
About three weeks. It was small at first.
Open your mouth, please. Yes, I can see it.
Is it bad?
Not yet. If you had come in six months, it would be much worse.
lines.tr: Henüz değil. Altı ay sonra gelseydiniz çok daha kötü olurdu.

lines.en: What must you do?
I can finish it today in twenty minutes.
Will it hurt?
You will feel nothing. But do not eat for two hours after.
lines.tr: Hiçbir şey hissetmeyeceksiniz. Ama sonrasında iki saat yemek yemeyin.

questions.q: When does the tooth hurt?
questions.note: "This tooth hurts when I drink something cold."

questions.q: How long has it been happening?
questions.note: "About three weeks."

questions.q: What does the dentist say about waiting?
options: In six months it would be much worse
questions.note: "If you had come in six months, it would be much worse."

questions.q: How long will the work take?
questions.note: "I can finish it today in twenty minutes."

questions.q: What must Volkan not do after the work?
questions.note: "Do not eat for two hours after."

lines.en: The men are coming at nine. Are the boxes ready?
lines.tr: Adamlar dokuzda geliyor. Kutular hazır mı?

lines.en: Almost. I finished the kitchen last night.
And the books?
The books are the problem. There are eleven boxes.
lines.tr: Kitaplar sorun. On bir kutu var.

lines.en: Eleven? We said we would give some away.
lines.tr: On bir mi? Bir kısmını vereceğiz demiştik.

lines.en: I tried. I gave away six and then I took two back.
lines.tr: Denedim. Altısını verdim, sonra ikisini geri aldım.

lines.en: That is exactly what I expected.
Do not start. What about the plants?
I will take them in my car. They break in a van.
lines.tr: Onları arabamla alırım. Kamyonette zarar görüyorlar.

lines.en: Good. And the keys? We must leave them for the owner.
lines.tr: Güzel. Peki anahtarlar? Onları ev sahibine bırakmalıyız.

lines.en: On the kitchen table with a note. I wrote it this morning.
lines.tr: Bir notla mutfak masasında. Bu sabah yazdım.

questions.q: What time are the men coming?
questions.note: "The men are coming at nine."

questions.q: How many boxes of books are there?
questions.note: "There are eleven boxes."

questions.q: What did Hakan do with the books?
options: Gave six away and took two back
questions.note: "I gave away six and then I took two back."

questions.q: Why will Ebru take the plants in her car?
questions.note: "They break in a van."

questions.q: Where are the keys?
options: On the kitchen table with a note
questions.note: "On the kitchen table with a note."

lines.en: You are new. Have you played before?
At school, but that was eight years ago.
That is fine. Half of this group started last year.
lines.tr: Sorun değil. Bu grubun yarısı geçen yıl başladı.

lines.en: I am worried that I will be too slow.
Everybody is slow in the first month. Then it changes.
lines.tr: İlk ay herkes yavaştır. Sonra değişir.

lines.en: How often do you meet?
Tuesday and Friday at seven. Come to one or both.
lines.tr: Salı ve cuma yedide. Birine ya da ikisine gelin.

lines.en: Do I need special shoes?
Not at first. Wear what you have and see if you like it.
lines.tr: Başta değil. Elinizdekini giyin, sevip sevmediğinize bakın.

lines.en: That is good advice. Most places want money first.
lines.tr: Bu iyi tavsiye. Çoğu yer önce para istiyor.

lines.en: You pay after four weeks. If you stop, you pay nothing.
lines.tr: Dört hafta sonra ödersiniz. Bırakırsanız hiçbir şey ödemezsiniz.

questions.q: When did Ozan last play?
questions.note: "At school, but that was eight years ago."

questions.q: What does the coach say about the group?
questions.note: "Half of this group started last year."

questions.q: When do they meet?
questions.note: "Tuesday and Friday at seven."

questions.q: What does the coach say about shoes?
options: Wear what you have at first
questions.note: "Wear what you have and see if you like it."

questions.q: When does Ozan pay?
questions.note: "You pay after four weeks."

lines.en: Good evening. I am in room two hundred and four.
lines.tr: İyi akşamlar. İki yüz dört numaralı odadayım.

lines.en: Is everything all right?
The room is clean but it is above the kitchen. It is very loud.
lines.tr: Oda temiz ama mutfağın üstünde. Çok gürültülü.

lines.en: I am sorry. Until what time?
Last night until one in the morning.
That is too late. Let me look for another room.
lines.tr: Bu çok geç. Başka bir odaya bakayım.

lines.en: Thank you. I am here for three more nights.
I have one on the fourth floor. It is smaller.
lines.tr: Dördüncü katta bir tane var. Daha küçük.

lines.en: Is it quiet?
It looks at the garden. Nobody has complained about it.
Small and quiet is better than big and loud.
lines.tr: Küçük ve sessiz, büyük ve gürültülüden iyidir.

lines.en: I will send somebody for your bags in ten minutes.
lines.tr: On dakika içinde çantalarınız için birini yollarım.

questions.q: What is wrong with the room?
options: It is above the kitchen and loud
questions.note: "It is above the kitchen. It is very loud."

questions.q: Until when was the noise?
questions.note: "Last night until one in the morning."

questions.q: How long is Seda staying?
questions.note: "I am here for three more nights."

questions.q: What is the new room like?
options: Smaller and looking at the garden
questions.note: "It is smaller... It looks at the garden."

questions.q: What will happen in ten minutes?
options: Somebody will come for her bags
questions.note: "I will send somebody for your bags in ten minutes."
